speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice)
question: Where shall the heart fix?
premises: The Lord's power, enjoying varied-unvaried-course and beyond-difference stations, ever goes, never into division, nohow.
So on this unagitated ground — Your step it is — may my heart-ground grow one-pointed, Bhairava Lord.
inference: Power walks undivided; heart prays one-pointed on still ground.
